challenges.title: Set up a factory
challenges.do: Run tessl init in a repository of your own and commit the tessl.json it writes.
challenges.check: Your repository has a tessl.json at its root, and the Tessl app shows the repository.

challenges.title: Ship your first issue
challenges.do: Write a small issue, such as fixing a typo or a stale README line, and hand it to your factory.
challenges.check: The factory opens a pull request that does what the issue asked.

challenges.title: Merge the factory's pull request
challenges.do: Review the factory's first pull request, ask for one change in a review comment, then merge it.
challenges.check: The factory answers your comment on the same pull request, and it merges.

challenges.title: Write an agent guide
challenges.do: Add an AGENTS.md that tells the factory your test command, your lint command and one house rule.
challenges.check: The factory's next pull request runs your commands and follows the rule.

challenges.title: Install a plugin
challenges.do: Install a skill or plugin from the Tessl registry into your repository.
challenges.check: tessl.json lists it, and tessl install fetches it.

challenges.title: Make the factory ask first
challenges.do: File an issue that leaves out something the factory needs, so it asks a question before building.
challenges.check: The factory comments with a question instead of opening a pull request, and builds once you answer.

challenges.title: Turn on code review
challenges.do: Set up Tessl Code Review on your repository.
challenges.check: Your next pull request gets a review from Tessl.

challenges.title: Add a review lens of your own
challenges.do: Write one quality standard your team cares about, such as naming or error handling, as a review lens.
challenges.check: A pull request that breaks the standard gets a finding that names it.

challenges.title: Write a skill
challenges.do: Write a small skill for a task you repeat, such as writing a release note.
challenges.check: An agent that has the skill does the task your way.

challenges.title: Review your skill
challenges.do: Run a review on the skill you wrote and fix one thing it suggests.
challenges.check: The skill's review score goes up.

challenges.title: Prove the skill works
challenges.do: Add an evaluation scenario for your skill and run it.
challenges.check: The evaluation shows the skill doing better than no skill.

challenges.title: Add a weekly maintenance loop
challenges.do: Add a schedule that runs a small chore every week, such as checking for stale docs.
challenges.check: tessl.json has the schedule, and its first run opens an issue or a pull request.

challenges.title: Keep the docs in sync
challenges.do: Set up a loop that checks your README against the code and proposes fixes.
challenges.check: It opens a pull request that corrects a line the code had made untrue.

challenges.title: Write a changelog loop
challenges.do: Add a weekly loop that writes a changelog from the pull requests merged that week.
challenges.check: Its run produces a changelog entry that names your merged pull requests.

challenges.title: React to a label
challenges.do: Add a trigger that starts an action when someone adds a label of your choosing to an issue.
challenges.check: Adding the label starts a run, and nothing else does.

challenges.title: Fix a failing check
challenges.do: Push a change that breaks a test on a factory pull request, and let the factory mend it.
challenges.check: The factory pushes a fix to the same branch and the checks go green.

challenges.title: Guard a public repository
challenges.do: Follow the public repository practices: only people you trust can start the factory.
challenges.check: An issue from someone outside the list starts no run.

challenges.title: Set up the environment
challenges.do: Add a setup hook so every run installs your project's dependencies before it starts.
challenges.check: A run's log shows the hook ran and the tests ran after it.

challenges.title: Watch your test health
challenges.do: Add a loop that looks for slow or flaky tests and reports them.
challenges.check: Its run opens an issue that names a test, or says all is well.

challenges.title: Bundle a plugin
challenges.do: Put your skill, and anything it needs, into a plugin in your repository.
challenges.check: Another repository can install it from yours.

challenges.title: Learn from past work
challenges.do: Point a loop at your merged pull requests and let it suggest a rule for the next ones.
challenges.check: It proposes a change to your agent guide or a skill, as a pull request.

challenges.title: Check a release
challenges.do: Add a release readiness check that runs before you tag a release.
challenges.check: Its run lists what is ready and what is not.

challenges.title: Show your badge
challenges.do: Add the Tessl badge for your repository to its README.
challenges.check: The README shows the badge, linking to your repository's page on Tessl.

challenges.title: Ship a gift
challenges.do: Hand the factory a real issue from your backlog, one you have put off, and merge what it builds.
challenges.check: The issue is closed by a pull request the factory opened.
